Static styles copied from the existing public Hanyang DB&AI Lab website to
preserve its design. PHP and WordPress/plugin JavaScript are not included.

Businessx 1.0.5.7 by Acosmin: GNU GPL version 3 (license header retained).
Businessx Extensions: original section styles, headers retained.
Bootstrap grid: original copyright/license header retained.
WonderPlugin Tabs: original static visual styles; interaction is implemented
in src/scripts/legacy-tabs.ts instead of its WordPress JavaScript.
KBoard Avatar: original static latest-news styles.
Poppins and Roboto font files: fetched from the Google Fonts CSS referenced
by the original site. Refer to the corresponding upstream font licenses.

CSS resource URLs have been rewritten to local files. An unused video-play
decoration already returning 404 on the source site is replaced with an empty
data URL. Source stylesheet URLs and image provenance are in docs/design-import.json.
